components.description: Enabled primary email action. Runtime disables it for invalid email or busy state.
components.css: .ds-email{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;min-height:50px;padding:0 20px;border:1px solid var(--vx-green,#1f6b54);border-radius:14px;background:var(--vx-green,#1f6b54);color:#fff;font:650 14px "Instrument Sans Variable",sans-serif;box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(11,91,69,.17);cursor:pointer;transition:transform 160ms ease,background 160ms ease,box-shadow 160ms ease,opacity 160ms ease}.ds-email:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--forest-deep,#0e352a)}.ds-email:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(23,73,59,.28);outline-offset:3px}.ds-email:active:not(:disabled){transform:scale(.97)}.ds-email:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-email:active:not(:disabled){transform:none}}

keyCharacteristics: Warm paper, dark ink, mineral green actions, and an ember identity accent.
One illustrative scene paired with a direct sign-in task.
Flat composition, restrained control borders, and generous desktop separation.
narrative.overview: This document is authoritative only for the built expert sign-in entry. Its direction is the incumbent warm ivory and mineral green Vyakti identity, with the ember Vyakti mark, concise text, and a fictional Indian educator at work. It does not replace a global design system or describe the authenticated product.
